ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast; surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with minimal high-intensity white pixel clusters estimated at < 5% of total visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous dark pigmentation field. High-contrast mapping reveals localized white circular and annular spots (rosettes) distributed across both lobes, with no large-scale white mottling visible.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with a sharp convergence point; estimated pixel angle between 60 and 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; significant jagged deviations and deep pixel-valleys are localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the median notch and sweeping laterally and upward toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter) across both lobes, presenting as light rings or solid white dots against the dark background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss on the lateral trailing edges, characterized by jagged, non-uniform excisions particularly prominent on the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.
